# Audio Soccer

> A football game you play by ear, made for blind and low-vision players. The Android app is played with the screen reader turned off: the game speaks its own menus in English or Persian through the phone's speech engine. A browser trial lets anyone try the game with a keyboard.

- The first Android release and the F-Droid listing are being prepared; no download exists yet. The app page will link to them when they are ready.
- The app needs Android 7.0 or newer and a speech engine such as eSpeak NG. It has no internet permission, no ads and no tracking.
- Three levels: find the ball, score a goal and beat the keeper. Each level has three rounds.
- Made by Babak Bandpey, Cocode (https://cocode.dk). Source code under the Apache-2.0 licence.

## Pages

- [Android app](https://soccer.cocode.dk/app/): what the app is, what you need, how a game goes, the touch gestures, and how to get it
- [Android app, in Persian](https://soccer.cocode.dk/fa/app/): the same page in Persian
- [Browser trial](https://soccer.cocode.dk/): play the three levels in a desktop browser with a keyboard, in English or Persian
- [Phone controls test](https://soccer.cocode.dk/phone/): try the touch controls on a phone, with the screen reader off
- [Privacy policy](https://soccer.cocode.dk/privacy/): the app collects nothing; settings and records stay on the phone
- [Privacy policy, in Persian](https://soccer.cocode.dk/fa/privacy/): the same policy in Persian

- [Source code](https://github.com/cocodedk/audio-soccer): the Android app (Kotlin), the browser trial and this site
